title: What Comes Next on the Chart?

steps.body: The chart can answer 'what comes next?' Find your number; the next square holds the next count.
steps.narration: The chart can answer 'what comes next?' Find your number; the next square holds the next count.

widget.prompt: On the chart, 29 ends its row. What comes next? Hop one and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 28 comes BEFORE 29. The next square holds 30.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 29 and count on one: you land on 30.
widget.successFeedback: After 29 the count wraps to the next row: 30.

predict.prompt: Counting on 1 from 29 — will you pass 30?
predict.reveal: 29 count on 1 reaches 30. 30 is a signpost, not a wall — the counting keeps going.

explanationVariants: The number right after 35 is the next one up: 36.

commonLandings.feedback: 34 comes just BEFORE 35. "After" means the next one up: 36.
37 is two after. Just one after 35 is 36.

widget.successFeedback: One hop up from 35 lands on 36 — the next number.
